# IATA.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v2) with a 12-month target of Rp91.0 against Rp72.0 (expected total return 26.1%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: dividend_income_anchor · method card: per fund record routing for Coal producers.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The free-float input contradicts the report's own ownership facts. free_float_pct is 44.06% in the 4 Nov pack but 7.21% in the 23 Oct pack used for v1/v2, with no change of substance in between; 44.06% plus the pack's in
- S16 describes the 19 October 663.23m-share transaction as "memborong ... dengan harga pelaksanaan Rp87" under a "skema harga" - an exercise price under a pre-agreed scheme, funded with Rp57.7bn - not an open-market purch
- The only evidence offered for the selloff is S18, an intraday IHSG note time-stamped 10:23 WIB on 3 Nov showing the index down 1.08% and top losers MORA and CBRE - it does not mention IATA, and it was published before S1

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
